theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have step (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hab : relation a b) i :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    convert ((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i using 1
    symm
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  have hd := step d e h.1
  have he := step e f h.2
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (R := ℤ) (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  intro i
  apply (IsCoprime.pow_right (n := i.1)
    (⟨3, -2, rfl⟩ : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  exact ((hs.sub ((hd i).add (he i))).sub
    (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))).trans (dvd_of_eq (by ring1))
